posts.title: Content tips
posts.body:
Would You Rather questions are one of the easiest video formats. They are short, everyone has an opinion, and viewers answer in the comments. Here are 100 questions you can film today. They are clean and friendly, so they work for any audience.

## How to film a Would You Rather video

**1. Answer fast.** Show the question as text on screen and say your choice in the first two seconds. Then explain why in one or two sentences.

**2. Ask the viewer.** End with "What would you pick?" People love to disagree, and comments help the video reach more people.

**3. Make it a series.** Post one question a day, or answer five in one video. Ask a friend or your partner to answer too, and compare.

## Everyday life

- Would you rather never use an alarm again or never be late again?
- Would you rather always be 10 minutes early or always be 10 minutes late?
- Would you rather give up your phone for a week or give up coffee for a month?
- Would you rather have a perfectly clean room forever or a perfectly organized phone forever?
- Would you rather wake up at 5 a.m. every day or go to bed at 3 a.m. every day?
- Would you rather never wait in line again or never sit in traffic again?
- Would you rather lose your voice for a week or lose your phone for a week?
- Would you rather always know what time it is or always know which way is north?
- Would you rather have no internet for a month or no hot water for a month?
- Would you rather only wear one color forever or only wear one outfit forever?
- Would you rather live without music or without movies?
- Would you rather have every red light turn green or always find a parking spot?
- Would you rather be able to pause time or rewind time by 10 seconds?
- Would you rather never get sick again or never feel tired again?
- Would you rather read minds for one day or be invisible for one day?

## Food

- Would you rather eat pizza every day or never eat pizza again?
- Would you rather give up sweets or give up salty snacks forever?
- Would you rather only eat breakfast food or only eat dinner food?
- Would you rather cook every meal yourself or never be allowed to cook again?
- Would you rather eat the same meal every day or never eat the same meal twice?
- Would you rather always have to eat spicy food or never eat spicy food again?
- Would you rather have unlimited free sushi or unlimited free burgers?
- Would you rather drink only water forever or never drink water again (but stay healthy)?
- Would you rather give up cheese or give up chocolate?
- Would you rather be a famous chef or a famous food critic?
- Would you rather eat dessert first every time or never eat dessert again?
- Would you rather have a personal chef or a personal driver?
- Would you rather only eat cold food or only eat hot food?
- Would you rather eat fries without salt or pizza without cheese?
- Would you rather try every food in the world once or eat your favorite food every day?

## Superpowers and fantasy

- Would you rather fly or teleport?
- Would you rather talk to animals or speak every human language?
- Would you rather be super strong or super fast?
- Would you rather see 10 years into the future or 100 years into the past?
- Would you rather breathe underwater or never need to sleep?
- Would you rather have a rewind button for your life or a pause button?
- Would you rather be the main character in a movie or in a video game?
- Would you rather live in a fantasy world or a sci-fi world?
- Would you rather have a pet dragon or a pet unicorn?
- Would you rather know how you will die or when you will die?
- Would you rather be able to change the past or see the future?
- Would you rather be famous now and forgotten later, or unknown now and famous after you're gone?
- Would you rather have a robot that cleans or a robot that cooks?
- Would you rather meet your future self or your past self?
- Would you rather live 200 years as you are now or 80 years as a superhero?

## Money and work

- Would you rather have $1 million now or $10,000 every month for 10 years?
- Would you rather do a job you love for little money or a boring job for a lot of money?
- Would you rather work 4 long days a week or 6 short days a week?
- Would you rather be your own boss or have a great boss?
- Would you rather work from home forever or in a cool office forever?
- Would you rather retire at 40 with a little money or at 65 with a lot?
- Would you rather be rich and unknown or famous and broke?
- Would you rather win the lottery or have your dream job?
- Would you rather have a long vacation once a year or a long weekend every month?
- Would you rather never pay rent again or never pay for food again?
- Would you rather get paid to travel or get paid to sleep?
- Would you rather start your own business or invest in a friend's business?
- Would you rather be the best in your company or the happiest in your company?
- Would you rather have a 1-minute commute and a small home, or a 1-hour commute and a big home?
- Would you rather give $1,000 to a stranger or get $100 for yourself?

## Travel

- Would you rather visit every country once or live in one country you love forever?
- Would you rather travel by plane only or by train only?
- Would you rather live by the beach or in the mountains?
- Would you rather travel alone or with your best friend?
- Would you rather explore space or the deep ocean?
- Would you rather spend a year in a big city or a year in a small village?
- Would you rather have a free first-class flight or a free 5-star hotel?
- Would you rather plan every detail of a trip or show up with no plan?
- Would you rather never fly again or never ride in a car again?
- Would you rather live where it's always summer or always winter?

## Social media and creators

- Would you rather have 1 million followers or 1,000 true fans?
- Would you rather go viral once or grow slowly every week?
- Would you rather only post videos or only post photos forever?
- Would you rather read every comment on your videos or never read any?
- Would you rather post every day for a year or once a month for a year?
- Would you rather be famous on TikTok or on YouTube?
- Would you rather have a viral video you hate or a video you love that nobody sees?
- Would you rather film everything in one take or edit every video for hours?
- Would you rather lose all your followers or lose all your photos?
- Would you rather never use filters again or never use music in videos again?
- Would you rather have a famous creator follow you or have your video shown on TV?
- Would you rather know exactly when to post or exactly what to post?
- Would you rather delete social media forever or post your screen time every week?
- Would you rather collab with your favorite creator or get a brand deal from your favorite brand?
- Would you rather livestream for 24 hours or post 24 videos in one day?

## Friends, family and feelings

- Would you rather have one best friend or ten good friends?
- Would you rather always say what you think or never say what you think?
- Would you rather relive your best day or skip your worst day?
- Would you rather be the funniest person in the room or the smartest?
- Would you rather forget your birthday or have everyone else forget it?
- Would you rather know what everyone thinks of you or never know?
- Would you rather have a big party for your birthday or a quiet dinner?
- Would you rather give the perfect gift or get the perfect gift?
- Would you rather be able to stop laughing at the wrong moment or stop crying at the wrong moment?
- Would you rather have a friend who is always honest or a friend who is always kind?
- Would you rather go back to school for one day or skip to retirement for one day?
- Would you rather be the oldest sibling or the youngest?
- Would you rather have your life turned into a movie or a book?
- Would you rather know all the answers or always ask the best questions?
- Would you rather say "yes" to everything for a day or "no" to everything for a day?

## Questions people ask

**What are good Would You Rather questions for TikTok?**
The best ones are quick to read, easy to answer in one word, and a little hard to choose. For example: "Would you rather fly or teleport?" or "Would you rather have 1 million followers or 1,000 true fans?"

**How do I film a Would You Rather video?**
Put the question on screen as text, say your answer in the first seconds, explain why in one or two sentences, then ask viewers to pick in the comments.

**Can I use these questions for free?**
Yes. Use any question from this list in your videos. If you want a new question every time, the KipFire app gives you Would You Rather cards to film.

## Get a new question every time

Lists run out. KipFire has a Would You Rather card type: open the app, get a question, react on camera, and post. The question shows on screen, so the video works even with the sound off.
